pairs.subject: docs-sync
pairs.evidence: scripts/docs/check-doc-sync.mjs:120 Touching any documentation directory prefix discharges the sync obligation for any changed source file, allowing changes to satisfy the check without updating their specific coupled document.

techniques.evidence: scripts/docs/check-doc-sync.mjs:120 Satisfaction is computed by directory prefix rather than the named target document.
scripts/docs/__tests__/check-doc-sync.test.mjs:88 Unmapped source files are pinned as silently passing, leaving 34.6% of tracked source files uncovered by construction.
scripts/docs/feature-doc-map.json:5 Entries declare only a single markdown file rather than an inventory of coupled prose surfaces (reference, tours, marketing) checked independently.
scripts/docs/check-doc-sync-diff.mjs:65 When no comparable git base exists, the script announces a skip but exits 0 rather than reporting an empty denominator.
scripts/docs/check-adrs.mjs:148 Validates that sources cited in ADRs exist on disk, but lacks the unverifiable verdict rung and broader corpus rot scanning.
scripts/docs/__tests__/keyless-e2e-pin.test.mjs:17 Parses source configuration as text without importing dependencies, asserting a non-empty population floor.
scripts/docs/__tests__/keyless-e2e-pin.test.mjs:73 Asserts mechanically that the hand-maintained list restated in guidance prose matches the source configuration in both directions.
scripts/docs/check-guidance.mjs:374 Enforces that runnable command paths printed in hook refusal messages and guidance files resolve relative to repo root.

pairs.registryProposal: While same-change enforcement properly recommends commit-range git diff checks with countable commit-trailer dismissals, satisfaction by directory prefix remains an exceptionally sticky defect when teams generalize the rule across multiple documentation folders.
